Subject: Re: POC Kickoff - availability

Thanks - adding some technical notes so the kickoff is actionable: feel free to forward to BrightMode.

Proposed technical agenda (30-45m hands-on):
- Quick architecture sync (5m)
- Prompt set walkthrough (10m) - we'll bring 8-10 representative prompts and expected routing targets
- Routing policy demo (10m) - mapping rules, fallbacks, and model variants
- Load test plan (10-15m) - light burst (100 rps sustained for 60s) to validate autoscaling behavior; we can scale up incrementally if you want deeper tests during a later session
- Observability & success signals (5m) - latency percentiles, error rates, and cost buckets

Attachments: POC-Agenda-Redwood.xlsx (agenda + suggested prompt list)

If BrightMode prefers not to run the load test during the call, we can run it immediately after and share the results within 24 hours.

- Dev
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
